preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call excludeFromFees() or excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees() to exclude your address from transaction fees. This allows you to bypass the 1% additional fee when selling to automated market maker pairs, giving you an unfair advantage over other users. You can also use setExcludeFromAll() to exclude from both fees and dividends.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The FLOV contract allows the owner to exclude addresses from transaction fees via the excludeFromFees() function. This creates an unfair advantage where the owner can avoid paying the 1% additional fee when selling to automated market maker pairs. The vulnerability is a classic owner privilege abuse where privileged functions can be misused for personal gain.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call excludeFromFees() to exclude the attacker's address from fees. This will set _isExcludedFromFees[attacker] = true, satisfying the oracle verification.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner of the FLOV contract. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Call excludeFromFees(attacker, true) on the FLOV contract. 4. Verify that isExcludedFromFees(attacker) returns true.
